params.body: control v0.16.3: verify --did-log takes every key #control-gateway ever had from the identity log, verifies each chain under the key that signed it and the attestation under the current one. A rebuilt machine with a new key then leaves its predecessor's chains verifiable here without a change to this workflow. The verdict still names the current key, read the same way, for the record.
params.title: The checker at v0.16.3 reads the gateway's key history from the identity log
